blocks.text: The Apple iPad Pro with the M4 chip is an incredibly thin, high-performance tablet featuring a Tandem OLED Ultra Retina XDR display, the powerful M4 chip for AI tasks, and support for the Apple Pencil Pro and a redesigned Magic Keyboard. It was released on May 15, 2024, and is available in 11-inch and 13-inch models.
